name: Nightmare's periodic trigger keeps its rider applied (#1518)
contract: Regression guard, not a fix. The issue names two ranks. Rank 1, Nightmare 300225, is the one whose description the issue quotes ('Terrify now reduces the Armor and magic resistance of nearby enemies'); it is not obtainable - obtainable.json reports 0 advancement rows, live_capture false, trigger_reachable false, calculator false and server_class_spell false, and it is the only spell in this audit slice absent from the bindmysoul snapshot, against a class-20 calibration where the live-client capture and the shipped CharacterAdvancement.dbc hold the same 222 spells in both directions. Rank 2, Nightmare 300226, is obtainable (advancement class 20 level 0, live_capture true) and does not use a proc aura at all: its single effect is aura 23 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL on Nightmare 301273 with Amplitude 500, which AuraEffect::PeriodicTick handles natively (SpellAuraEffects.cpp, '23 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL'). This scenario pins that native behaviour: learning the passive must keep 301273 applied within one tick interval. It is expected to pass both before and after this batch - nothing in the batch touches 300226.

steps.label: The rider is absent before the passive is learned
Its native periodic trigger applies Nightmare 301273
